title: Tübinger registry for Morbus Adamantiades-Behcet
summary: Behcet's disease is a vasculitis and is rare, especially in Germany. The purpose of this study is to expand the data base on the different manifestations of your disease, as well as the possible influence of the origin or type of autoantibodies present and possibly other autoimmune diseases present. We hope this will improve the care of patients

interventions.name:
Observational study - 1 arm:
Clinical manifestations of Behcet's disease.
Origin
Ethnicity
Religious affiliation
Education
Smoking status
Evaluation according to the 2 different classification criteria
